result.question: Quais são as 10 principais causas de morte (com descrição)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."CID_MORTE" = c."CID" WHERE i."MORTE" = true GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_mortes DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS causa_morte, COUNT(*) AS total_mortes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."CID_MORTE" = c."CID" WHERE i."MORTE" = true AND i."CID_MORTE" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_mortes DESC LIMIT 10;
